Still, she’s the **only jumper here who can realistically challenge Mahuchikh** if both are at their best.

The **2022 World Champion**, Patterson has been **solid but not spectacular** lately. She’s hit **1.97m multiple times** (Banská Bystrica, Nanjing) but hasn’t cleared 2.00m since 2023.
